title: Get fast proof of board and side-panel interactions

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The maintained Board swipe test caught an unintended launch dialog after a phone swipe started on the enabled Start execution button.

**Story and promise.** SEED-413#speed-dashboard-board-and-panel-proof at `56ff0790ffbfeeda72c36bddec1376c4e432dbb5`. The seed’s phone example and P09 in the plan’s source review require a horizontal swipe to page the Board without activating Start under the touch.

**Fault and observation.** In an isolated checkout, I exempted button targets from the post-swipe compatibility-click guard in `dashboard/src/boardSwipe.ts`. This kept headline suppression in effect and reached the test’s Start-button iteration. The ready story “Record the ready interaction” supplied an enabled Start execution button. The maintained test performed a native left swipe from it and dispatched a simulated compatibility click to the original target. A temporary read-only DOM observer recorded that this click reached Start execution and opened “Start execution in Claude Code.” The unchanged no-dialog assertion at `dashboard/frontend-tests/navigation/board-swipe.spec.ts:112` failed on that open dialog after paging and selection checks had passed. [Fault log](/tmp/dough-intent-board-swipe.Gz2BTI/fault.log) · [Screenshot](/tmp/dough-intent-board-swipe.Gz2BTI/fault.png)

**Run and restoration.** With Node 24.21.0 and a locked `npm ci` on AC power, I ran `caffeinate -s -i npm run --silent test:dashboard:frontend -- dashboard/frontend-tests/navigation/board-swipe.spec.ts --workers=2 --grep 'swiping from a card or action'` three times. The sole selected case passed at baseline, failed under the fault at the assertion above, and passed after restoration. I compared the source bytes and clean Git status with the pre-fault checkout and then removed the scratch worktree. [Baseline log](/tmp/dough-intent-board-swipe.Gz2BTI/baseline.log) · [Restored log](/tmp/dough-intent-board-swipe.Gz2BTI/restored.log)

**Next proof action.** Retain the existing no-dialog assertion for the observed Start path. No additional proof is needed for this fault. The result matches the plan’s existing slice 2 disposition for P09.

- **Test runtime.** 4.53 s baseline, 16.96 s faulted, and 4.33 s restored (measured, Vitest runner durations).
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separate human effort measure was collected.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separate active agent effort measure was collected.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 162452 ms (measured), from 1795281124789 to 1795281287241 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

**Wrap-up disposition.** Checked `56ff0790ffbfeeda72c36bddec1376c4e432dbb5`. Caught. No follow-up.
